description: Fast Math port for NeoForge 1.21.1 — originally created by EliasB.

mods.name: SuperFastMath
mods.description:
This mod optimizes commonly used mathematical operations in Minecraft.

Optimizations:
- Faster sine and cosine via optimized lookup tables
- Hardware-accelerated square root where applicable
- Improved floor and clamp operations
- Optimized interpolation (lerp) using fused multiply-add
- Optimized BlockPos bit-packing for faster chunk coordinate encoding

mods.name: SuperFastMath
mods.description:
This mod uses precomputed sin and cos via a table and sets them dynamically, which makes math way faster.

Optimizations:
- Faster sine & cosine via optimized lookup tables
- Hardware-accelerated square root (native SQRTSS instruction)
- Improved floor and clamp operations
- Optimized interpolation (lerp) using fused multiply-add
- BlockPos bit-packing for faster chunk coordinate encoding
